hosts: Azure arcw2 first (idle after round B), two 8-thread lanes (seeds 1-2, then 3-4); other workers only once their round-B lanes finish

protocol.data: tools/run_adsb_rctx.py --held-out 2025-10 --design: fit on the in-scope rows (matched_no_lirf) of the eleven other 2025 months (the residual stage's leave-one-month-out fold for October, as rnet's and adj2/cat's October columns), target label - cross-fit v9, monitor October every epoch (record only; fixed 16 epochs, final-epoch weights); write October's predictions only.
protocol.decision: The development round (twelve-month leave-one-month-out on the recipe months plus a twelve-month refit) goes ahead only if the 4-seed rctx mean's recipe reading (all October rows) at its best w is at least 0.02% below the control AND its paired-day 95% interval lies below zero. The development declaration then fixes the seeds and the candidate weights from these October readings alone. Otherwise Round C stops with a recorded null.
protocol.never_read: No design run predicts or scores a recipe month (2025-01/07/11/12) or a ranking month; those months enter only as fitting rows, as in every leave-one-month-out fold.
protocol.readings: tools/rctx_design_report.py: October scope RMSE and v28's non-LIRF recipe on October with the residual stage 0.05 adj2 + 0.05 cat + 0.9 x ((1 - w) rnet + w rctx), w = 0.1..1.0, against w = 0 (the incumbent stage); LIRF rows at v9 for every candidate.

purpose: Round C design (the user's 'Ok proceed'): does a context network as a residual-stage member (tools/run_adsb_rctx.py) improve on rnet? October only, declared before any design fit.
smoke: tools/run_adsb_rctx.py --smoke on arcw2 (design and refit12 modes, 30,000 rows, one epoch, output under /tmp) passed before this declaration; no design reading was produced
